safetyIthos.0.t: This is not a toy. It is a decorative night light.

safetyIthos.1.t: Not suitable for children under 3 without adult supervision.

safetyIthos.2.t: Keep the cable out of a cot or a bed.

safetyIthos.3.t: Do not leave batteries within reach of a small child.

safetyIthos.4.t: Wipe with a dry cloth. Never with water or solvents.
